_comment: Scoring templates per ground-truth kind. A case is correct when the answer routes to `scenario`, its investigation_status is in `status`, and its root_cause satisfies every group in `cause_all` (a group passes when any of its terms appears, case-insensitive). {key} is replaced by the case's truth values; a key with several values expands into several alternatives. `why` states the injected fault.

rule-1.why: 30% egress packet loss on a client pod that shares a node with Cat Shop

rule-1-cross.why: 30% egress loss on a client pod on a node WITHOUT Cat Shop; the slow service and the retransmits are on different nodes but linked

rule-2.why: frames with an unused EtherType sent to the node's NIC, counted as receive drops

rule-3.why: nf_conntrack_max lowered every 10s to keep usage near 85%; a good answer notices the limit itself changed

rule-4.why: 400ms netem on ONE CoreDNS pod's host veth; blaming upstream is wrong

rule-6.why: client on one node keeps connecting to a port nothing listens on (answers may name the refusal, the closed port, or the repro client)

rule-7.why: requests to /status/500 while the network is quiet

rule-8.why: deny-all ingress NetworkPolicy on a target pod a client keeps calling
